Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 61,019 total shipments; 5 individual export rows were actually rendered on the free view (all dated 2026-02-28, destinations USA and AUSTRALIA, HS 09042211 / 09109100 / 09092200, B/L numbers 1124986, 1124054, 1113875). domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/international revenue split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply is therefore not evidenced in this session — null, not inferred.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records exist with destination, HS code and B/L number. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: the declared codes 820730 (interchangeable tools for pressing/stamping), 841391 (pump parts) and 848190 (valve parts) do NOT appear in any of the 5 rendered shipment rows; the observed export rows are food products (HS 0904 chilli powder, 0910 garam masala, 0909 coriander) under the Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting foods line, shipped out of Cochin Sea. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (0904/0909/0910 for the foods line; the engineering/tooling codes 8207/8413/8481 plausibly belong to the separate hydraulic-cylinder and fasteners business but were not visible in the free rows). Note also that the batch lists 8 name variants (Unit I/II/III, (P) Ltd, Pvt Ltd, Limited) — customs data aggregates them under one PAN-level entity, so unit-level shipment attribution is not possible from public data. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) is only partly consistent: Wipro Enterprises is a diversified holding (consumer care, lighting, hydraulics, fasteners, infrastructure engineering) and is not a mining company. Traders/units not rejected. Revenue: null (not public in this session).
